The '''son''' of a [[Mon Calamari]] [[Unidentified Mon Calamari viceroy|viceroy]] ran away with his [[Quarren]] lover [[Shuggoth]] aboard her [[starship]]<ref name="Chapter 22" /> some time around [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|17}}</ref> His mother [[Capture of a Mon Calamari viceroy's son|hired]] a [[Bo-Katan Kryze's unit|group of Mandalorian]] [[privateer]]s led by [[Axe Woves]]. The Mandalorians tracked down Shuggoth's [[Unidentified Quarren freighter|ship]] and took the young prince away, intending to return him home.<ref name="Chapter 22" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Mon Calamari appeared in [[Chapter 22: Guns for Hire|Chapter 22]] of [[Jon Favreau]]'s [[Disney+]] television series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which aired on [[April 5|the 5th of April]], 2023.

The Mon Calamari viceroy's son is performed by [[David St. Pierre]] and voiced by [[Harry Holland]].
